0022600167.text: The Rockets, 5-1 and second in the West, host the Celtics, who are 4-1 and third in the East, with Houston coming off a loss and Boston riding a four-game winning streak. Houston is without Fred VanVleet (knee), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not yet met in the 2026-27 season, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Rockets losing the last meeting 114-93 in Houston on February 4, 2026.
